follow_ups.title: Wire promotions-api and promotionsdb into AppHost (and teststack)
follow_ups.reason: src/eShop.AppHost/AppHost.cs has no promotionsdb or promotions-api resource, so the service cannot start under Aspire; this is outside the service subtask's owns.

follow_ups.title: Register 'promotions' ApiResource/ApiScope (and swagger client) in Identity.API Config.cs
follow_ups.reason: Identity:Audience=promotions needs a matching resource and scope for tokens used on GET /api/promotions.

follow_ups.title: Associate testing/teststack.json with the JSONC language mode in the LSP/editor config
follow_ups.reason: The generic JSON language server reports false 'comments not permitted' errors on this intentionally JSONC file, which blocks the verifier on any future change to it.

follow_ups.title: Associate testing/teststack.json with the JSONC language mode
follow_ups.reason: The LSP reports 'Comments are not permitted in JSON' on a file the tooling intentionally treats as JSONC; mapping it to JSONC would stop the false errors for future subtasks.

follow_ups.title: Make eslint and markdownlint available in pipeline worktrees
follow_ups.reason: npm run lint fails with 'eslint: command not found' in fresh worktrees, so implementers can only run the C# part of the lint CI runs.

follow_ups.title: Let the LSP tooling treat comment-tolerant JSON config files as JSONC
follow_ups.reason: scripts/lsp/config.json maps every .json file to strict JSON, so the diagnostics check blocks files whose readers deliberately skip comments (StackConfig, ports.mjs), which led to the add-then-remove churn on testing/teststack.json.

follow_ups.title: Tenant-scope promotions (story's multi-tenancy section)
follow_ups.reason: No tenant concept exists in the codebase yet; the admin API should filter by and stamp the current tenant once the multi-tenancy epic adds one.

follow_ups.title: Outbox has no retry for failed promotion events
follow_ups.reason: Events marked PublishedFailed in IntegrationEventLog are never re-sent (same as Catalog.API); a start or end event lost to a RabbitMQ outage stays lost.

follow_ups.title: Policy review passes changed_files without git statuses, so every new EF migration is flagged as modified (DATA-001)
follow_ups.reason: reviewRound in scripts/review/lib/review.mjs sends implChanges() names as a plain list, and _normalize_changed in architecture-policy/hooks/architecture/engine.py marks each one M. Every story that adds a migration hits a false BLOCK that no amount of rework clears. Fix: pass {path: status} from git diff --name-status <base> (untracked files as A), or let the engine compute statuses from base when it gets a list.
